_doc: Drift gate baseline for release_gates.yaml:drift.baseline_file. Records the v1.3-era ASHRAE 140 validation results at the time this file was committed so the release_gate_checker drift gate can detect unexpected regressions in pass-rate, MAE, or case-by-case pass/fail transitions against the historical floor. The schema mirrors the dict that scripts/release_gate_checker.py writes under --update-baseline (root-level `cases` dict + `summary` block with pass_rate/mae/passed/failed), so the script can read this file with no schema translation.
_rule: Per AGENTS.md / RULES.md (no parameter tuning, no silent loosening): this file records the KNOWN v1.3-era floor; it must never be raised to hide a regression. Only update values when the engine genuinely improved, and commit the improving change together with the baseline update. The strict-energy-gate baseline (tests/reference_data/zone_balance/strict_energy_gate_baseline.json) follows the same anti-tuning discipline for the per-Case-600/900 annual-energy subset.
_stale_threshold_doc: scripts/ci/test_release_gate_checker.py::test_drift_baseline_file_is_fresh fails CI when `captured_at` is more than this many days old — guards against the file silently going stale and the drift gate tripping on a frozen reference.
source_command: cargo run --bin fluxion -- validate (regenerates docs/ASHRAE140_RESULTS.md and validation_results.json, then `python3 scripts/release_gate_checker.py --update-baseline` overwrites this file)
